import numpy as np
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    bg=np.bincount(I.flatten()).argmax()
    seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool)
    comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop()
                    if seen[x,y]: continue
                    seen[x,y]=True; cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and I[a,b]!=bg and not seen[a,b]:
                            stack.append((a,b))
                comps.append(cells)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    block=comps[0]; marks=[cells[0] for cells in comps[1:] if len(cells)==1]
    rs=[p[0] for p in block]; cs=[p[1] for p in block]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    sub=[[int(I[i,j]) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    h,w=len(sub),len(sub[0])
    # alignment: block centered on marker: marker at center of block bbox
    o=np.full_like(I,bg)
    for rr,cc in marks:
        for i,row in enumerate(sub):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                a=rr-(h-1)//2+i; b=cc-w//2+j
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W: o[a,b]=v
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in o.tolist()]
D=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(D==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
